~Is ARKbar free to enter? | Yes. Entry to ARKbar on Chaweng Beach is free every day, including the pool party, the fire shows and the beach party; you pay only for what you eat and drink. Special events such as the New Year's Eve countdown are ticketed (500 THB standing in 2026).
What time is the fire show at ARKbar? | The first set starts at 20:00 on the sand in front of the main stage, and there is a new set at the start of every hour until midnight. It is free and runs every night, weather permitting.
What time does the ARKbar pool party start? | The pool party runs from 14:00 to 19:00 every day and is busiest from 16:00 to 19:00. On Wednesdays and Fridays a saxophonist, violinist and dancers join the DJ.
Can children go to ARKbar? | Yes, until 21:00. There is a separate children's pool with a slide, and the 20:00 fire show is fine for families, but under-18s are not admitted after 21:00. Pool use for non-hotel guests carries a 500 THB minimum spend per person, children included.
How much is a sunbed at ARKbar? | A walk-in beachfront sunbed has a 300 THB minimum spend, credited against food and drink, with no booking needed. Pool access for non-hotel guests is a 500 THB minimum spend per person, and booked tables start at about 2,000 THB minimum spend depending on the table and season.
How much is a beer at ARKbar? | On the 2026 menu, Leo and Singha cost 120 THB, Heineken 140 THB and Chang 150 THB for 330 ml. Most cocktails are 220–280 THB and buckets start at 650 THB.
How much is ARKbar on New Year's Eve 2026? | A standing ticket costs 500 THB for the whole night, with doors at 17:00 and advance sales closing on 25 December 2026; a few are sold at the door. Table packages cost 15,000–50,000 THB. The event is 18+ with photo ID.
Is there parking at ARKbar? | Yes. A car costs 500 THB a day and a scooter 100 THB a day, both credited to food and drink, and hotel guests park free. There is no parking on New Year's Eve, and you should never ride home after drinking.
How late is ARKbar open? | The beach club is open from 10:00 to 02:00 every day, and the beach party runs from 20:00 to 02:00. Event nights can run later; for clubs after 02:00 walk to Soi Green Mango.
How do I get home from ARKbar at night? | Walk if you are staying in central Chaweng. Otherwise take Grab, which surges after 02:00 and in rain, or a Beach Road taxi with the fare agreed first, about 300–500 THB to Bophut or Lamai. Songthaews mostly stop by 20:00–22:00.
